description:
Apple backend declares GeneratedFiles: false (apple.go line 439). This prevents injection of:
- Skills files (.claude/forage-skills.md)
- Permission configuration
- Agent identity/certificates
- Secret mounts

Docker solves this by embedding GeneratedFileMounter (docker.go line 38). Apple needs the same pattern:
- Embed GeneratedFileMounter in AppleRuntime struct
- Implement MountGeneratedFile method
- Stage files before container startup
- Pass additional --mount args to container create
- Set capability to true
title: Apple runtime: implement GeneratedFileRuntime interface for file injection
